title: Book Two · Chapter 117: The Last Copy
story:
Two weeks pass. The correction notice stays near the school gate. Only one square remains empty on Ronan's list.

On a bright Monday, Mei brings him a guide. A younger pupil gave it to her at the drawing table. The back page still says Wednesday.

Ronan takes it to the reading room. He puts a clean strip across the wrong line. Before he writes, he checks the current notice again.

Thursday after lunch. This term.

He writes the line and gives the guide back to Mei.

“Can you give this to the pupil?”

“She is coming here after lunch,” Mei says. “You can give it to her.”

Ronan keeps the guide on the table.

Mei opens it to her picture. “The stairs still show.”

“Yes. They help.”

“I know. A girl followed them yesterday.”

She sounds pleased. Ronan is glad she can be pleased about her part.

After lunch, the younger pupil comes with a friend. Ronan gives back the corrected guide and explains the day.

“I did not use that page,” the girl says. “My mother keeps the book days on another paper.”

“Please change that paper if she used mine.”

The girl nods. “She uses the school notice.”

Ronan watches her put the guide away. He marks the last square on his list. He leaves the public correction notice up for Miss Wu.

Miss Wu checks the list after lessons. She asks about each description. Then she puts the list with the school guide papers.

“We have found and corrected all eighteen copies,” she says. “Keep giving the right information.”

“Can we make another guide?”

“Not this term.”

Ronan looks down. “Because of me?”

“The school has enough guides now. We also need other work. You can join the ordinary reading activities.”

He nods. He wants a fresh page with no old mistake on it. Miss Wu is already reaching for the next group's book.

Outside, Jun is beside the wall. He throws a soft ball up and catches it with one hand.

“Can I have a turn?” Ronan asks.

Jun looks at the ball, then tosses it to him.

Ronan catches it against his chest. They throw it five times. Neither boy speaks. On the sixth throw the ball reaches too high. Jun jumps and misses. It drops behind him.

“Your arm is longer than your aim,” he says.

Ronan grins. He runs to get the ball. When he returns, Jun is still there. They play until the gate begins to close, then leave in different directions.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

current＝现行的；aim＝准头；ordinary＝普通的；description＝描述。

## 理解问题

1. 所有找到的副本更正完，是否表示所有关系恢复？
2. Ronan和Jun课后做了什么？

## 读句子

**Ronan / keeps / the guide on the table.** Ronan／把指南／留在桌上。
